evidence: Reviewed all 94 criterion descriptions (2 gate, 80 Functional, 6 Polish, 6 Visual) with their complete injected context/protocols. Workbook Quality Checks row 33 (check 32) and matching Internal row 33 require concrete browser outcomes, durable evidence and distinctive probes; the internal row adds no exception. The criteria meet that standard: gates/render/judge.toml:25 requires a fresh computed marker in both live preview and console, not source literals; gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29 requires an actual UI write, clean-context server-supplied identity/three-field retrieval and reload, and expressly does not infer SQLite from browser data. Functional prompt.md:7,13,15,19 excludes implementation reads/guessed routes/hidden execution claims while allowing entered snippet source as product data and observed requests. S02-S19 collect distinct authored outputs, errors/source lines, real before/after pictures, console contents, measured durations, queue outcomes and rendered editor properties (prompt.md:114-412). S21-S23 and S37-S38 collect exact identities/revisions/fields/history, independent editors, successful controls and fresh state after accepted/rejected/retried/paired operations (418-480); no response shape alone establishes a mutation/refusal. In particular, restore retry requires both the original acknowledgement and unchanged fresh head/history after a later Save (470-471), and races require one complete winner and exactly one additional history revision (477-480). Polish uses actual keyboard routes/focus observations and a resized usable workspace (polish/prompt.md:43-51, judge.toml:23-68). Visual specifies rendered properties and five concrete anchors per topic with same-surface cross-viewport comparison (visual/judge.toml:24-104; prompt.md:42-56). Feasibility was exercised through the installed @playwright/mcp 0.0.79 in a disposable network-isolated verifier container, using the frozen headless/isolated Chromium flags. evidence/32/results.json and requests.jsonl/responses.jsonl record five successful capability checks: a clean context without copied localStorage, the exact frozen S07 recipe returning controlPassed=true/baseline=2, route cleanup, route.fetch plus response abort and actual UI retry returning the same committed revision with fresh state unchanged, and Promise.all paired in-page requests with fresh state count=2. execution.json binds image, command, exit 0, source and output hashes. This tests tool capability, not candidate correctness. All 60 raw-evidence-index artifact SHA256 values matched (evidence/32/index-verification.json). The hash-verified history-results.json contains actual retained historical fields, a restore at revision 4, a later head at revision 5 while retry still returns revision 4, a controlled UI lost reply/retry both returning revision 6, and 200/409 race results with one whole winner/history entry. Those are supporting scripted product observations, not configured judge verdicts. Counterexample challenge: a mock copying quoted source cannot meet the computed Run gate; a retry handler that returns the old result but writes another revision fails fresh head/history comparison; a permanently dead console or refusing-all app cannot satisfy the named successful controls. Conforming alternatives checked: server-rendered library data is explicitly accepted; proactive stale prevention still receives draft credit with an observed-format server replay; static last-good pictures and disabled old handlers are allowed after Stop; no JSON schema, label, API verb, exact revision increment, origin match or private source read is required. No row-32 false pass or false fail was substantiated. Scope limits: no provider/configured judge/Oracle/portal run and no restart_app invocation were made. S22 correctly requires a completed restart before its browser readbacks (functional/prompt.md:23,430-434); app_context.md:28 distinguishes missing observation from product failure. Existing scripted Docker restart evidence is not represented as shared restart-tool or full judge success. Shared user-deferred restart behavior and global required runtime measurements remain with their owning checks; this Pass establishes only row-32 criterion design and demonstrated browser-tool feasibility, not task clearance.
